capabilities: Aggregate tasks from configured vault folders
Filter and sort tasks by status, priority, dates, tags and keywords
Display tasks in 19 views including kanban, matrix, calendar, Gantt and task tree
Edit task marks individually or in batch with snapshot rollback
Chart task statistics as pie, stacked bar and heatmap views
extras: Batch edits write directly to Markdown files; the README recommends Git backups and offers snapshot rollback for the last batch edit. Mobile is not yet supported. Time Statistics view is under development.
problem: Tasks are scattered across vault files with no unified dashboard to review, filter, visualize and bulk-edit them across files.
summary: Task management panel that aggregates Markdown tasks into 19 views (list, kanban, matrix, calendar, Gantt, task tree, statistics) with global filters and batch editing.
